blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Mandaue City has allocated P60 million for the Gugma sa Pasko program food and grocery package for residents in December 2026. The Mandaue City Council passed on first reading an ordinance establishing the Gugma sa Pasko Mandaue Food Assistance Program, which targets an estimated 80,000 qualified residents.
